notes.title: VR version & DLC are now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33265723/01182d0057b16d9c756fd8f044f42a2936ba147e.jpg

Dear Fellow Virtual Anglers,
today we are giving you another extension of our game. VR support was one of the first things you asked for, and the topic with VR support requests had several pages.

From the beginning of this great game, we've been trying to listen to your feedback and make the changes you asked for. So it happened this time ... it only took us a little more time.

Here they are, with players in mind we have created VR both as a separate product:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1024010/Ultimate_Fishing_Simulator_VR/

and as a DLC for current owners of the classic version:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137540/Ultimate_Fishing_Simulator__VR_DLC

EARLY BETA ACCESS for VR and VR DLC
This is our first contact with VR and it requires a lot of work from us. In order to enable playing the VR version as many people as possible, we want to introduce compatibility with the most popular VR headsets and controllers.

Due to implementing VR, we discovered that the game engine used in the basic version of the game needs to be updated and many game functions will need to be rewritten.

We also want to make as many gameplay features as possible playable with VR controllers, as well as create UI that's comfortable to use in VR. 

This will take some time and this why we want to let you know that this DLC will be updated for the next 1 to 2 months.

So...I hope you will enjoy VR version of this great game and will help us to make it even better!

Kind Regards,
Rafał - Project Manager in Ultimate Games S.A.

notes.title: Game Update | 01-02-2019
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We are releasing a new game update which should bring some bug fixes and promised Sakura© casting reels. 

Changelog:
Version: 1.0.19

Added / New:

 New reels:
Casting:

 Sakura© Kuanza 2.0 (black),
 Sakura© Kuanza 2.0 (white),
Changes:
 Increased physical reels durability,
 Lowered required level for maps,
Fixes:
 Fixed critical gameplay bug that makes game unplayable,
 Fixed fish species duplication in "wiki fish",
 Fixed server auto-ban security, that was banning people at Bass Marshland map,
 Small correction in in-game texts (descriptions, etc.)


Bans caused by server security at Bass Marshland
In recent days, several people have been banned in the game with displayed ban reason as: "catching fish". 

It was caused by wrong server-side anti-cheat configuration at our new map -  Bass Marshland.

We were trying to unban everyone as fast as we can. If you are still banned without a reason, please create a ticket here: https://professionalfishing.freshdesk.com

Of course, everyone is compensated in the form of VIP days and cash in the game.

Critical gameplay error caused by 1.0.18 patch
After a few days of searching for errors and the reasons for their creation, we finally succeeded - we found the source of problems and eliminated them. We would like to apologize to everyone for this event. If with the update 1.0.18, your game ceased to be unplayable, I would very much ask you to create a support ticket. We'll compensate for your lost time.

Scale size of fish
Soon, we should release also a new patch, which will introduce major changes to the fish scaling system. Thanks to this, large fish will finally look big. This system involves many other things, such as a new system of pulling fish out of the water and fish presentation (you wouldn't be able to hold 60kg catfish in real-life). Unfortunately, we can't do this at the same time and we have to do things one by one.

Here is a sneak peek of 55kg wels catfish:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33173199/4e863de5c5e71a02c43b2b4e9cf11f6a6201c967.png

Therefore - first we will release a patch with a new fish scaling system and later the other ones. 

Reels durability
Many times you mentioned on the forum that the reels are too weak, so we decided to make some change introducing more realism. The durability of the reel will be several times greater.

Why? Until now, the value of the drag in the reels corresponded to the weight of the fish he could pull out. However, as we know, in reality, it looks a bit different, because the "water buoyancy" works on fish, which makes them seem lighter when we pull them. We've introduced a similar rule to the game, so reels are now 'stronger'. We hope you will be satisfied with it.

New fish species and more bones
Also in the next patch, we should release a new wels catfish model which will have higher quality textures and more bones. It will allow us to show in another way how the player holds fish, ex:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33173199/020709435146b9434d527111ec0dddc9cd81ad3c.jpg https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33173199/84e930874e6f78b09ce6c808a0cbcc3d02062c74.jpg

Also, our 3D designer is working on new catfish species, how you could see above :) First new catfish will be - "Flathead" 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33173199/0c65935ebb237cf340643f559f759b5c1f8e9756.jpg

Hope you like it :)

-----
Kind Regards,
Rafał - Project Manager in Ultimate Games S.A.

notes.title: (BIG) Game Update | 26-01-2019
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
today we are releasing our first big update containing a new map, few new fish species, new equipment, and a few bug fixes.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33173199/667490846cca051bfe1388634343cf6b94f31c42.jpg

In this update, we focused on players feedback regarding fish species in USA map - more accurately - on the bass species (we should change species on old USA map soon). Together with them, we are also releasing casting rods and reels* (*we will add more of them next week). 

About Bass Marshland
Bass Marshland is a vast swamp, located in North America. A characteristic feature for them is that without a boat you can not move between islands, so if you can't swim - better don't go here. In Bass Marshland you'll find many bass species, including peacock bass, striped bass, crappie and much more. Rumors say that the largest Striped had 57 kg!

notes.title: What's Next? | Let's look at the upcoming update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 
Today we wanted to share with you some news about the upcoming update. The whole team works in the sweat of the forehead to introduce new things to the game and fix existing bugs.

Are you wondering why there are fewer updates lately?

This is related to the fact that we decided to release updates less frequently - however, they will contain more bug fixes and / or new features, items, etc.

What will the new update bring?
For a long time, we thought about what should we do in the first place. We read many of your ideas and opinions, thanks to which the choice was much simpler.

Many people mentioned that species of fish on the US map are simply wrong, therefore, you could see many pictures of new species of fish.

Contents of the new update:

 New map
 7 new fish species

 Bluegill
 Pumpkinseed
 Peacock bass
 Smallmouth bass
 Striped bass
 White crappie
 Black crappie

 Casting method 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33173199/8b7c8f352d343da07f2d8a176559e0b60f1b89fe.jpg


Casting
In the upcoming update, we were most interested in implementing the casting method to function properly in the game. We did not focus on creating a dozen models of rods and reels, which would also be difficult due to the size of our team.

On the day of the upgrade, the game should contain
about 4 rods and 4 casting reels.

notes.title: Game Update | 06-12-2018
notes.notes:
Version: 1.0.4

Changelog:

Added / New:
 New rod durability parameter - kilograms,
 32-bit build available is now for everyone,


Fixes:
 Fixed rod durability*,
 Fixed bug displaying "1 level",
 Fixed colliders on Germany map (now you should be able to cast everywhere), 



Rod durability
Today is the first step in new durability system. From now the rods have the maximum weight they can carry. If the player will try to pull a fish bigger than the endurance of the rod - it will be gradually worn out. 

*We also fixed the bug that caused all rods to have the same durability. Therefore, players had a lot of problems with pulling fish on more expensive fishing rods - because they had the same max. weight as cheapest one.

In a few days we should add more changes ex. rod C.W., reels drag (kg), lures (weight), baits (weight), floats (weight) and more! 

Changed prices
As many of you have noticed, we have changed the prices of some items such as fishing rods. They are more expensive now.

Why did we do this? With the introduction of new parameters, we had to balance the sense of the existence of different rods and make space for new items.

The range has become so big because the catfish is one of the strongest rods in the game. Between her and the cheapest, there will be a lot of new models.

Cheaters

Kind Regards,

notes.title: Game Update | 13-11-2018
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
today's patch brings long-awaited improvement in fish size scale. It took us a while but here it is.

Fish scale is now based on real-life LWR (Length-Weight Relationship). Every species in the game had its own data chart with a curve. We created it with help of:
- IGFA World Records Database
- FishBase (fishbase.de)

I hope that now you will have a better feeling of the game by catching fish whose weight corresponds to their size (length).


Changelog:

Added / New:

 The ability to control the boat during reversing,

Changes:

 Fish scaling now is based on individual Length-Weight Relationship parameters,

notes.notes:
Version: 0.26.10

Changelog:

Added / New:
 New Map: Enchanted Rivers
 New fish species on Enchanted Rivers: Brown trout, Barbel, Ide, Grayling, Eel, Burbot, Bleak.
 Players are now visible on boats (this element is constantly improved, and it is highly possible that you will occur some bugs). After finishing work on the boats, we will implement it for ground vehicles.

Changes:
 Better adapted fish size to its weight. Fish sizes have been improved to better reflect their weight.
 Small changes in the economy of the game: fishing rods, reels, and boats received new prices and greater durability.
 Changes in the frequency of fish bites (especially when using spinning).
 Small visual changes in the game weather.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33173199/49e306de67ec3af096b0624018237c1779952d75.jpg

About Enchanted Rivers

Enchanted Rivers is another map for our game, but this time we are moving from Russia to ... Poland :)

The ER is much larger than Russia, which You will be able to check by yourself soon. The biggest difference between Poland and Russia will be the possibility of reaching the fishery from every side of it. You will not encounter on this map invisible walls that will block access to the fishery.

You will find here fish species available in Russia but you can catch several new species at Enchanted Rivers, including Brown trout, Barbel, Ide, Grayling, Eel, Bleak or Burbot.

Hope you will like it!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33173199/2938f81f54cbf615f639af93c007e16cebae256f.jpg

Feedback
As always, we want to ask you to write all the comments, opinions, suggestions here -  on the forum. We try to read every post and analyze all problems.

That is why today, together with the new map, we ask you not only to express your opinion about the map but also about any bugs and problems you ecountered.

Kind Regards,
Rafał Jelonek
Project Manager in Ultimate Games S.A.
